welcome.title: Welcome to ClimaBalance
welcome.description: Climate certification platform. We connect carbon offsetting to direct support for audited rural properties.
welcome.step1Description: Answer simple questions about your consumption to calculate your CO2 emissions.
welcome.step2Description: Support verified reforestation areas across Brazil.

dashboard.title: Your Climate Impact
dashboard.noActivityDescription: Your recent calculations and compensations will appear here

hero.title: Climate technology connecting carbon, land, and real impact
hero.description: ClimaBalance is a climate impact platform that brings people, companies, and audited restoration areas together through footprint calculation, project selection, and verifiable certification.

whatIs.label: What it is
whatIs.title: A platform that turns climate intention into traceable action
whatIs.paragraph1: ClimaBalance was created to make carbon compensation clearer, more trustworthy, and more connected to the territory where restoration happens. It helps users understand emissions and direct support to audited reforestation and regeneration areas.
whatIs.paragraph2: Instead of treating compensation as something abstract, the platform structures the process with an interactive map, socio-environmental criteria, contribution traceability, and impact certificates with validation.

partnerCall.label: Partnerships
partnerCall.title: We are looking for partners to keep building the project
partnerCall.description: The platform is under development, and we are looking for strategic, technical, and institutional partners to expand its environmental and social impact.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.title: A simple flow with end-to-end transparency
howItWorks.description: The experience is designed to connect calculation, decision, and validation for people and organizations that want to offset emissions with more confidence.
howItWorks.step1Description: People and companies provide consumption and activity data to estimate emissions and understand their carbon footprint.
howItWorks.step2Description: Users explore audited areas, compare project information, and choose where to direct their compensation.
howItWorks.step3Description: After compensation, the platform records the operation, preserves traceability, and provides a certificate with validation mechanisms.

objectives.label: Objectives
objectives.title: What ClimaBalance is designed to enable
objectives.description: The project aims to combine decarbonization, operational trust, and direct support for initiatives restoring ecosystems.
objectives.card1Description: Make carbon footprint understanding easier and broaden access to concrete compensation actions.
objectives.card2Description: Direct resources to properties and initiatives evaluated with socio-environmental criteria and execution evidence.
objectives.card3Description: Strengthen trust through audit trails, certificates, evidence records, and transparency about where compensation goes.

scope1.title: Scope 1 - Direct Emissions
scope1.description: Emissions from sources directly controlled by the company
scope1.whatIsDescription: Stationary combustion (generators, boilers), mobile combustion (own fleet), fugitive emissions (air conditioning, refrigeration)
scope1.tip: Leave blank items that don't apply to your company

scope2.title: Scope 2 - Purchased Energy
scope2.description: Indirect emissions from purchased electricity consumption
scope2.whatIsDescription: Indirect emissions from generation of purchased and consumed electricity. Includes all units (offices, factories, stores, etc.)
scope2.consumptionHelper: Add all energy bills for the period

scope3.title: Scope 3 - Value Chain
scope3.description: Indirect emissions from the company's value chain
scope3.whatIsDescription: Indirect emissions from activities not directly controlled: product logistics, employee commuting, corporate travel, suppliers, among others
scope3.tip: Scope 3 can be estimated. Leave blank categories you don't have data for
